TCS-5005.locator: Abstract and PDF pages 1–2, introduction and contributions
TCS-5005.finding: The paper answers its introductory adaptive-scaling question affirmatively with an asymptotic guarantee. This should not be presented as an untouched open existence question.

TCS-5247.finding: The paper provides adaptive and nonadaptive MNL learners and lower bounds. Secondary accuracy and logarithmic factors remain; do not call the entire quantitative problem resolved.

TCS-5399.finding: PPAD-hardness holds for tree polymatrix Nash equilibrium with twenty actions per player. The general tree case in the card is not a remaining unclassified tractability frontier.

TCS-5701.locator: PDF page 15, Conjecture 16 and surrounding paragraph
TCS-5701.finding: The authors label the proposed universal transfer false, subject to the stated drastic-complexity-collapse caveat. Bijectivity remains coNP-complete in the block-parallel model. This is not an independently posed surviving conjecture.

TCS-5750.finding: The extracted open question is polynomial-time general graph isomorphism, including equivalent orbit-partition tasks. The paper's later method-comparison questions must not replace that introductory target. Consolidate under TCS-7222.

TCS-6299.finding: The paper proves a trichotomy for regular trail queries and that the tractable regular-language class is larger than under simple-path semantics. The introductory equal-complexity comparison is answered.
